capabilities: embed Excel tables and sheets in notes via excidian code blocks
edit cells and write changes straight into the .xlsx workbook
add rows that inherit formatting and fill in calculated columns
enforce Excel data-validation rules with dropdowns and checks
resolve onedrive: paths and flag OneDrive sync-conflict copies
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Desktop can reach workbooks outside the vault via Node fs; mobile is limited to files inside the vault. Only edited cells are written; formulas are not recalculated until Excel reopens the file.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or edit Excel workbooks from notes, so working with spreadsheet data means leaving the app or keeping duplicate copies.

relations.evidence: OneDrive-aware: one note works on every computer; conflict copies are flagged

summary: Spreadsheet embedder that displays Excel tables and sheets inside notes and saves cell edits directly back into the .xlsx file.
